risks.mat_why_0: Control '{name}' does not exist or is not configured. Zero effectiveness — no risk reduction.
risks.mat_why_1: '{name}' exists ad-hoc but without a formal process. Minimal, inconsistent reduction.
risks.mat_why_2: '{name}' is documented with basic application. Partially reduces the risk.
risks.mat_why_3: '{name}' is defined, documented and applied systematically. Substantial reduction.
risks.mat_why_4: '{name}' is actively measured and managed. High effectiveness and consistency in reduction.
risks.mat_why_5: '{name}' is fully optimized with continual improvement. Maximum possible effectiveness.
risks.mat_why_partial: (partial implementation — effectiveness is limited by incomplete coverage).
risks.mat_why_planned: (planned only — provides no real reduction until implemented).
risks.mat_why_not_impl: Control '{name}' is not implemented. It provides no reduction to the residual level.
risks.api_key_missing: API key not configured. Go to Configuration > AI Agent.
risks.created_email_body: Risk {code} has been created with residual level {level}/8.
risks.no_asset_value_note: No asset has an estimated value configured
risks.cannot_request_acceptance: A risk in status '{status}' cannot request acceptance
risks.not_pending_acceptance: The risk is not in PENDING_ACCEPTANCE status
risks.asset_no_value: The asset has no estimated value configured (Asset.estimated_value)
